task: Fossil fuel dependency index by US state (incl. DC) for 2017

files.role: roof solar theoretical potential per state
files.key_column: state_name (full state name, 1 row per state + 1 'NULL' aggregate row)
notes: one row with state_name='NULL' is not a state and must be dropped
51 real state rows: 50 states + District of Columbia
state_name is already a full name, matches electricity price file naming

files.role: monthly net generation by state, producer type and energy source (2001-2022)

key_columns.TYPE OF PRODUCER: filter == 'Total Electric Power Industry' to avoid double counting sub-categories
key_columns.ENERGY SOURCE: fossil = 'Coal', 'Natural Gas', 'Petroleum'; a 'Total' row exists and equals the sum of the components

notes: TYPE OF PRODUCER has 6 values; 'Total Electric Power Industry' is the aggregate -> used
sum of source rows equals 'Total' row within rounding (<5 MWh) for all states
all 51 states/DC have complete 12 months in 2017; no missing generation values
state keys are abbreviations -> mapped to full state names

files.role: monthly average retail electricity price by state/region, sector

key_columns.stateDescription: full state name; also contains census divisions and 'U.S. Total' which must be excluded

notes: 51 state-level entities for 2017 industrial, all with 12 monthly price values
annual value computed as the simple mean of the 12 monthly prices
revenue/sales weighted annual price differs by < 0.5% for most states (max ~4% for Idaho); mean chosen for simplicity
price column has some blanks in other sectors/years -> not relevant for 2017 industrial

join.keys: full state name; generation abbreviations mapped via 2-letter -> full name dictionary
join.coverage: 51/51 entities present in all three sources (50 states + District of Columbia)

quick_stats.note: see output.csv for per-state values; Texas largest fossil generation, California largest roof solar potential
